common.tagline: AI-Driven Scheme Matching for Marginalized Entrepreneurs

landing.headline: Your path to financial empowerment starts here
landing.subtitle: Find the right NSFDC concessional credit scheme, calculate your EMI, and locate the nearest authorized channel partner — all in one place.
landing.path_form_desc: Answer 4 simple questions about your project type, cost, and income. Get an instant, exact match.
landing.path_ai_desc: Tell us in your own words what you're looking for. Our AI will extract the details and find matching schemes.
landing.feature_match_desc: Deterministic rule engine matches you to NSFDC credit schemes in under 100ms. No AI guesswork — 100% reproducible results.
landing.feature_calc_desc: Calculate projected EMIs with scheme-enforced caps. See moratorium periods, interest breakdowns, and repayment schedules.
landing.feature_locate_desc: Find the nearest SCA, bank, or NBFC-MFI authorized to process your loan category, with health-based ranking.
landing.income_cap_desc: This platform uses ₹5,00,000 as the annual income cap per the Problem Statement text. The live NSFDC figure is ₹3,00,000. Both figures are stored — this is a documented, deliberate choice for demo accuracy.

intake.title: Tell us about your project
intake.subtitle: Answer 4 questions to find matching NSFDC credit schemes instantly.
intake.cost_hint: NSFDC schemes cover projects from ₹0 to ₹50,00,000
intake.state_label: Your state (for welfare schemes & SCA matching)

recommendation.title: Your Scheme Recommendations
recommendation.handoff_desc: This platform helps you find the right scheme — it does NOT process loan applications. To apply, visit the PM-SURAJ Portal with your matched scheme details.

footer.built_for: Built for the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
footer.disclaimer: This platform does NOT process loan applications. It routes you to the official PM-SURAJ Portal for application submission.
